setupIntroHtml: A step-by-step assistant: each step only asks the questions your earlier answers make possible (features you don't switch on, a VAT regime you don't have, a country that doesn't apply — nothing is asked for nothing). Every question says where it is set in the app and links to the guide. Your answers are saved automatically in this browser. The last step checks that everything fits together, then Export XML produces the file: the app imports it (Workspace settings → Import workspace) to create settings, accessories and floor plan; the <setup> section of the same file carries everything else.
setupGuideHtml: The complete user guide — with a screenshot of every screen, long forms merged into one image — is {link} (English · Français · Deutsch · Español · Italiano) and in the app (Settings → Help).
setupSecretsHtml: Only put a token or credential here if you are filling in this document privately. The exported file is plain text: for e-invoicing and online payments you can leave the fields empty and enter the secrets directly in the app, where they go to the server and never come back.
setupExpertMode: Show everything on one page (expert mode)
envDev: Development — for trying things out: the app says so everywhere and watermarks every document
envProd: Production — the invoices it issues are really owed
numResetHint: The counter cannot restart more often than the printed date changes — otherwise a number already issued would come back.
exigInvoice: On invoices (accrual) — VAT is due when you invoice
exigPayment: On receipts (cash) — VAT is due when the customer pays
outsideWalkupDesc: walk-in arrival yes, advance booking no
outsideOffDesc: nothing outside the hours, overlaps included
granHours: Real hours (exact from–to, half/full days as shortcuts)
vatNoteUS: The United States has no federal VAT — sales tax varies by state and locality: enter your combined local rate by hand.
vatNoteCA: Canada taxes by province: keep the line for yours (GST, HST or GST+PST/QST) and delete the others.
vatNoteCH: The special 3.8 % rate only applies to accommodation.
helpAppRegion: Workspace settings (currency, time zone) · Settings → Region & formats (each member)
helpAppWhole: Editor → Space QR codes and whole-space reservations
helpAppPackages: Settings → Billing → Day packages · Money → Payments → Buy a package
helpAppLegal: Invoices → Legal identity, VAT and mentions
helpAppVat: Invoices → Legal identity → VAT rates · VAT declarations
helpAppKiosk: Members & plans → a member → Make kiosk device
helpAppPrivacy: The shield at the top of the screen (Privacy & data)
helpAppConsent: The GDPR consent screen on first launch · Settings → Privacy & data → Your data, your rights
helpAppNegotiations: Members & plans → a member → Price negotiation · Money → Statement → My negotiated prices
helpAppSupplies: Money → Payments → Submit an expense → “supply for the workspace”
helpAppFaces: Money tab — Statement · Payments · Invoices · Documents
helpIconTitle: Help — in the app: {app} (opens the guide)
reqName: The name is printed on every document and identifies the workspace in the app.
reqSellerAddress: The seller's address is mandatory on an invoice.
reqVatId: You declared the {regime} regime: the VAT number must appear on invoices.
reqRegNumber: A company must print its registration number on its invoices. (An association does not have to.)
identityWhy: The name, the country and the currency decide everything that follows: the currencies and time zones offered, the invoice format, the payment methods, VAT.
identityNameHint: The name shown everywhere: app, invoices, invitations.
identityBrandColorHint: Optional: a #RRGGBB colour the app derives its light and dark themes from. The app refuses one that would be unreadable, naming the pair.
identityEnvironmentHint: A development workspace says so on every screen and watermarks “DEVELOPMENT” on every document. Only choose “production” if the invoices it issues will really be owed. Default: development.
identityCountryHint: Suggests the currency, time zone and usual VAT rates; decides e-invoicing (EU) and which bank details are asked for (IBAN, sort code, routing…).
identityCurrencyHint: ISO 4217 code. The app knows how many decimals each one has (the yen has none, the dinar three).
identityTimezoneHint: IANA name. Every booking slot is anchored to it; each member can display the time in their own.
identityLanguageHint: Invitations and reports are written in it by default.
identityAddressHint: Printed on invoices and on the kiosk receipt.
identityErrBrandColor: The brand colour must be written #RRGGBB.
identityWarnCurrency: The currency {currency} is not the country's ({expected}): intended for a cross-border workspace, otherwise a mistake.
featuresWhy: Tick what your workspace uses: the following steps will only ask about those features. Everything can be changed later in the app (Settings → Features), and switching a feature off deletes nothing.
featuresIndentHint: An indented feature depends on another one: it is only offered while that one is on, and its row says which.
featuresTechnicalHint: Reserved switches no business process lists yet.
featuresWarnMoney: Money tab off: no subscriptions, services or invoices will be asked about.
featuresWarnOnline: Online payments: the PayPal/Stripe/Mollie/Wero keys are entered in the app (Settings → Online payments), never here.
featuresWarnKiosk: Kiosk mode without NFC or QR badges: members will identify themselves by e-mail or code.
availabilityWhy: When the workspace is open and how it is booked. The server applies these rules everywhere: plan, Reserve tab, QR/NFC scan, kiosk.
availGranularityHint: Without “Working hours”, only half days and full days exist.
availHourEquivalents: Conversion to half days (“real hours” granularity)
availHourEquivalentsHint: Booked time is converted into half-day equivalents for the quota and the invoice.
availAllowPastDesc: Record a booking that has already ended (yesterday and earlier) after the fact. Booking an earlier time on the same day is always allowed.
availAdminCheckoutDesc: An admin can end a member's running check-in; otherwise check-out is strictly personal.
availOutsideHoursHint: “Off” also refuses a window that runs over (16–20). “Spontaneous only” lets a walk-in arrival through at either edge of the day and refuses advance bookings. “Free” allows without counting or charging. “Charged” (default) counts as ordinary usage, except on days when the member already holds a booking within the hours.
availLegendProfileHint: “Every state” (default) shows Free · Reserved · Checked in · Mine · Blocked, so you can see who has arrived. “Fewer states” shows four — Free · Reserved · Mine · Unavailable — and a booked seat then looks the same as one somebody has checked into. Both the legend and the colours on the plan follow this choice.
availSimultaneousHint: How many reservations may overlap for the same member, check-ins included. 1 by default. A higher personal allowance is granted member by member (Members step) and takes precedence over this number.
availNoPoliciesHint: Without this feature: no past bookings, personal check-out, outside hours charged, one reservation at a time.
availHorizonHint: Beyond it, the booking is refused.
availMinDurationHint: An arrival at 11:45 with a 12:00 boundary is refused as too short.
availMaxDurationHint: A booking ends on the day it starts.
availMatrixSummary: How bookings will behave (the server's summary)
availMatrixBookingHtml:
RequestHalf daysFull daysMinute grid (5/15/30/60)Real hours / free period
Morning or afternoon✅❌ full day required✅ if the edges fall on the grid✅
Whole working day✅✅✅✅
Unusual window (9–15)❌❌✅ if on the grid✅
Before opening / after hoursAnswer to “Outside the opening hours”: off, spontaneous only, free or charged.
Off the grid (10:02)——❌ the refusal names the grid—
On every granularity: minimum and maximum duration; nothing crosses midnight; yesterday and earlier ❌ unless “past bookings”; a walk-in check-in starts today; beyond the horizon, closed day, seat taken: a named refusal; simultaneity per the allowance.
availMatrixCheckinHtml:
Check-in / check-out / cancellationBehaviour
Walk-in arrival (free seat, QR/NFC, kiosk)From now to a canonical edge; if that widened slot is unavailable, the booking is anchored at arrival. At the end of the day, extended to midnight. Must start today.
Check-in on a bookingHalf days, full days, real hours: the whole booked day. Minute grid: 15 min before the start or one grid step.
Check-outBefore the booked end: shortened to now. After: a truthful timestamp. By an admin: only with the dedicated setting.
CancelFuture: one gesture. Running: “End early” or a validated deletion request. Past: a validated deletion request (“Deletion requests” feature).
availErrStartEnd: Day start and end: the start must come before the end.
availErrBoundary: The half-day boundary must fall between the start and the end.
availErrMinMax: The minimum exceeds the maximum — no booking would be accepted.
availErrHours: Real hours: a full day must be worth more hours than a half day, and both more than zero.
planWhy: Describe the structure — the app generates a starting plan that you refine in the editor (background photos, exact positions, NFC tags on chairs).
planDeskOpacityHint: 0–100 %. Lets the level's background photo show through the drawn desks. 100 = opaque desks.
planNfcHint: NFC/RFID tags on chairs are set up in the editor: open the seat and bring the chip close — the field fills itself (Android, Chrome browser on Android).
planSitesHint: The default site carries the workspace's address. Add a site for every other address, then attach its levels to it.
planNoWholeHint: Offices and levels will not be bookable as a whole; desks and seats will.
planWarnOfficeNoPrice: Office {office} bookable as a whole without a price: it will be free.
billingWhy: What a subscription costs by its percentage, the rate for each half day beyond it, and the day packages members will be able to buy.
billingTiersHint: The monthly price by subscription percentage, and the rate for an overage half day. The bands must cover 0–100 % with no gap.
billingPackagesHint: Packs of days to buy (Money → Payments → Buy a package). Without a package, the “Packages” option of the Members step is not offered.
billingErrTierNoFee: Band {from}–{to} % without a fee: the row would not be exported.
billingWarnNoTiers: No fee band: subscriptions will be free until you add some in the app.
billingErrGap: The bands do not cover 0–100 % without a gap.
billingErrLevel: The {n} % level falls in no band.
legalWhy: What appears on your invoices and what the authorities expect: legal form, registration, VAT regime, rates, declarations, e-invoicing platform.
regimeExempt: Exempt / small-business scheme (with a VAT number)
legalVatRegimeHint: Decides the following questions: rates, declaration period, exemption reason.
legalRegNumberHintAssociation: Association register no. · company ID if assigned
legalExemptionHint: E.g. “VAT not applicable, art. 293 B of the French tax code” or “VAT exempt under …”. Printed on every invoice.
legalVatRates: VAT rates (the first becomes the default rate)
legalVatRatesHint: A starting point, not tax advice: in the app, every service/package/accessory can carry its own rate.
legalNoVatManagementHint: VAT-registered without “VAT management”: invoices will go out without rates. Switch the feature on to enter your rates.
legalVatExigibilityHint: When the tax becomes due: on invoicing, or when the customer pays. In France services are taxed on receipts unless the business opts for invoices. This choice decides what a period declares, and it is printed on every invoice.
legalInvoiceNumberingHint: One gapless series per journal: the number is taken in the database when issuing. The format applies from then on; an issued document never changes.
legalMemberNumberingHint: The member number is assigned on joining and never changes; it appears on the invoice as “Member no.”.
legalVatPeriodHint: The period your regime requires. The declaration adds up what the period carries according to the chosen due point — invoices issued (accrual) or payments received (cash) — per rate (CA3, UStVA…), and is transmitted or exported as PDF/XML.
legalDunningHint: The delay before the first reminder is also the payment term: once it has passed, an open invoice reads “overdue” in the app.
dunningAutomaticDesc: Every morning — and as soon as an owner or admin opens Money — open invoices past the term get their next reminder level: an alert in the member's feed and a notification. Unticked: a reminder stays a manual gesture.
einvoiceHint: Where DesKilo delivers your EN 16931 invoices: an accredited platform, a Peppol access point, a national platform. The token is stored on the server and never leaves it — only put it here if you are filling in this document privately.
einvoiceTestEnvsHint: Separate endpoints and tokens for rehearsals; the choice only appears when sending if the workspace's developer mode is on.
einvoiceCustomer: Delivery service to the customer (second destination)
einvoiceCustomerHint: Separate from the government platform: the customer's Peppol access point, their portal or the agreed API.
legalNonEu: Outside the European Union ({country}): no EN 16931 e-invoice, the signed PDF invoice is enough.
legalWarnNoRegNumber: No registration number: invoices will lack it.
legalErrVatIdRegistered: VAT-registered regime without a VAT number.
legalErrVatIdExempt: Exempt regime without a VAT number.
legalWarnNoExemption: No reason VAT does not apply: the default legal wording will be printed.
legalErrAddress: Incomplete billing address (street, post code, city).
legalWarnEinvoiceToken: E-invoicing platform without a token: enter it in the app.
legalErrDunning: Reminders: at least one level and one delay.
servicesWhy: What members consume on top of their seat: services by the unit (lockers, printing…) and accessory supplements per half day.
servicesAccessoriesHint: The supplement is charged per booked half day. 0 = free.
servicesVatHiddenNotSubject: VAT column hidden: the workspace is not VAT-registered.
servicesErrNone: Services switched on but no service defined: the feature would be empty in the app.
accessoriesErrNone: Accessory supplements switched on but no accessory defined: the feature would be empty in the app.
payWhy: What a member sees on an unpaid statement: how to pay you. The fields asked for follow the country's banking system.
payHint: Leave empty to show nothing. The reference is shown to the member so the transfer matches by itself.
payBicHint: Transfers from outside the SEPA area.
payWeroHint: Wero works in the euro-area countries that have joined it.
payOnlineDep: Online payments switched on: the PayPal, Stripe, Mollie or Wero keys are configured in the app, on the server — never in this document.
payWarnNone: No payment instructions and no online payment: members will not know how to pay.
rolesWhy: Who can do what, and which actions wait for a confirmation before they count. The owner always holds every permission.
rolesDefaultMatrixHint: Without role management, the default matrix applies: admins manage members, documents, services and expenses and view the finances; co-owners have everything.
rolesAdminInvoicingDep: {feature} is on: the feature itself delegates the permission to issue invoices to admins.
rolesDefaultRuleHint: It applies to every domain without a rule of its own. Nobody validates their own event.
rolesDomainsHint: Tick a domain to give it its own rule; unticked, it inherits the default rule. Only the domains of your features are offered.
rolesWhoValidatesHint: Named people are chosen in the app, once members are invited (Settings → Validation rules).
rolesAutoDeleteHint: The only exception to “nobody validates their own event”, limited to booking deletions. Two independent switches, off by default.
rolesErrDefault: The default rule requires at least one validation.
rolesWarnValidators: {required} validations required but only {possible} possible validator(s) (owner + invited admins).
membersWhy: Who is invited at the start, on which plan — and the message they will receive.
membersHint: **Days used up**: blocked (default), pay as you go{packages}. **Limit**: the cap on open reservations in total (empty = no cap).
membersHintWhole: **Whole spaces**: the right to book a whole desk, office or level.
membersHintSimultaneous: **Simultaneous**: the personal overlap allowance, which takes precedence over the number from the Availability step.
membersWholeTitle: Can book a whole desk, office or level
membersPackagesHidden: “Packages” option hidden: no day package defined.
membersInvitesHint: Leave empty to use the built-in translated message. Placeholders: {firstName}, {lastName}, {phone}, {workspaceName}, {workspaceId}, {inviteLink}, {downloadUrl}, {role}. The invitation goes out in the language chosen when sending, otherwise in the workspace language.
membersConsent: On first launch, every member (you included) accepts the GDPR consent screen — the text version and the date are recorded on their account; nothing to configure here, but your invitation can mention it. The text stays readable at any time in the app and the guide.
membersErrLevel: {who}: subscription {pct} % is not one of the levels offered.
membersErrNoEmail: {name} has no e-mail: the row would not be exported.
membersWarnNone: No member to invite: you will invite them from the app.
membersWarnWhatsapp: The WhatsApp link does not look like a group link.
summaryWhy: What the app will switch on and how your answers configure it. Untick what you don't want: the feature starts switched off and its configuration is neither exported nor offered in the app — you can always switch it on later in Settings → Features.
cfgEventsTab: Event feed and confirmations; default rule: {required} validation(s){owner}, {domains} rule(s) per domain.
cfgOnlinePayments: PayPal / Stripe / Mollie / Wero — the keys are entered in the app (Settings → Online payments).
cfgEinvoiceTodo: e-invoicing platform to configure in the app
cfgPushNotifications: Confirmations pushed to devices (Firebase to configure on the server).
cfgNfcBadges: Check-in by NFC/RFID card at the kiosk.
cfgBadgeSignIn: Sign-in by badge + personal code (each member activates their own).
cfgKioskMemberPhotos: The member's photo on the kiosk receipt.
cfgWhatsappTodo: Group link to fill in (Members step) or in the app.
cfgHourEquivalents: half day = {half} h, full day = {full} h
cfgInvoicePdfTemplate: Report editor for invoices and documents.
cfgDocuments: Library of Drive/OneDrive/SharePoint… links per role.
cfgDunning: {levels} level(s), 1st reminder after {first} d (= payment term), then every {between} d.
cfgRemindersAuto: Automatic reminders every morning and whenever an admin opens Money.
cfgMemberReports: Self-service financial agreement and payments report.
cfgNotRegistered: Not applicable while the workspace is not VAT-registered.
cfgCustomerServiceTodo: Customer delivery service to configure in the app.
cfgPlanObjectDelete: Deletion of plan objects still referenced (audit substitution).
cfgNotificationGrouping: Feed groupable by type, day or member.
cfgNfcSeatTags: NFC/RFID tags on chairs (set up in the editor).
cfgFormHelpHints: Help cards and tip carousels on every screen.
cfgRegionalFormats: Each member chooses numbers, dates, clock and time zone; workspace: {currency}, {timezone}.
cfgCalendarHub: The calendar shows everything that has a date, with access rules per category.
cfgDataAccessLog: Each member sees who viewed their finances.
cfgMemberDataExport: GDPR export (art. 20) and leaving with erasure (art. 17).
cfgFinanceFaces: Money in four faces: Statement, Payments, Invoices, Documents.
cfgSupplyExpenses: An expense can be a supply: once validated, it restocks a consumable service.
cfgScopesNone: Rule scope: admins everywhere (named people in the app).
cfgMemberEnvironments: When inviting, the choice “also give access to production” (the test workspace is given in every case).
cfgWorkspaceLibrary: Workspace templates (plan and settings): save, share by e-mail, apply by merging from the library.
cfgMemberOrigin: Each member carries how their membership began: founder, invited, or profile created by an administrator.
cfgUiAnimations: Animated transitions (the system “reduce motion” setting takes precedence).
cfgScheduledExpenses: Recurring expenses validated once, each due date confirmed by the member (“Scheduled expense” validation domain).
cfgPriceNegotiations: Per-member conditions — subscription, overage, discount, price per service and package, occupancy — validated by the “Price negotiation” rule; permissions View/Manage commercial agreements.
summaryCountHint: {active} feature(s) will be switched on, {inactive} will stay off. Everything can be changed later in the app.
summaryOk: {active} feature(s) on, {inactive} off — each with its configuration.
reviewWhy: Everything the assistant checked, step by step. Blocking items must be fixed; warnings are choices to confirm.
reviewGateBlocked: The export will open once these {n} item(s) are resolved:
reviewNothingLost: Nothing is lost: your answers stay saved in this browser while you go back.
reviewImportHint: Export the XML, then import it in the app: Workspace settings → Import workspace.
renderStepFailed: This step could not be displayed.
renderStepFailedHint: This is a fault in the assistant, not in your answers — they are intact. The other steps work; report it with this detail:
